To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Bi2Se3/SnS thin film heterojunction has been successfully fabricated by thermal evaporation and its optoelectronic characteristics were investigated.

the fabricated Bi2S3/ SnS heterojunction exhibits a high-performance photoresponse from 200 to 1000 nm, and this performance is due to the enhanced separation of electron–hole charge pairs under the influence of an electric field at the heterojuncton's interface.

the Bi2Se3/SnS thin film heterojunction photodiode exhibits a remarkable photoresponse in the visible spectral range with a high photocurrent gain of 8460% and an external quantum efficiency of 45% at 600 nm.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the fabrication and investigation of a wide range Bi2S3-based photodetector by utilizing the SnS thin film.
the development of high-performance optoelectric devices based on Bi2S3, SnS, and the Bi2S/SnS heterostructure.
the development of a high-performance photodetector based on the Bi2S/SnS heterostructure.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Bi2SnS heterojunction has been successfully synthesized and characterized.
the Bi2Sn heterojunction phototransistor has the potential for use in high-performance optoelectric devices.
the Bi2Se3/SnS thin film photodetector has been successfully fabricated and characterized.

a bilayer Bi₂S₃/SnS thin film heterojunction photodevice was fabricated and characterized.
we have developed a new type of heterostructure based on Bi2S3-SnS that has not been reported before and we have investigated its optical and electrical properties in detail.
the Bi2Se3/SnS bilayer heterojunction is a good candidate for optoelectronic applications.

the Bi2SnS3/Sn2S3 heterojunction photodiode is a promising candidate for the development of high performance optoelectronics.
the Bi2s3/SnS bilayer heterojunction is an effective photodetector that is suitable to detect the wide range of visible light.
the heterojunction structure can be used as a photodetector with wide spectral sensitivity and high gain.
